text:
maria (Docs): Heads-up — API change: server now prefers Request-Id over Idempotency-Key for dedupe on v2. We need to update docs and SDK snippets before the deprecation announcement.

samir (SDK): Thanks for the ping. Where's the authoritative spec? I didn't see it in the release notes.

maria (Docs): infra-bot posted the change in #eng-infra earlier, but short version: on v2 we will honor Request-Id (header) for idempotency and treat Idempotency-Key as legacy for 90 days with a warning header. We should show both examples in migration guide.

clem (Frontend): This breaks a small client helper we ship in the examples (we set idempotencyKey in the client). I can patch the snippet quickly but prefer to have an explicit migration note.

samir (SDK): I'll open SDK PR to accept both names in the client API surface but prefer new param name requestId. Plan: keep backwards compatibility by mapping idempotencyKey -> requestId internally and log a deprecation warning. PR draft: #7890.

maria (Docs): Perfect. For docs: can we add a short code block showing old -> new? Keep it tiny. Also add an HTTP example for infra teams.

samir (SDK): Here's a tiny snippet I drafted for Node + Python — feel free to copy.

samir (SDK): ```js
// Node (old)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-11b', prompt: '...', idempotencyKey: uid });
// Node (new)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-11b', prompt: '...', requestId: uid });
```

samir (SDK): ```py
# Python (old)
client.generate(model='redwood-11b', prompt='...', idempotency_key=uid)
# Python (new)
client.generate(model='redwood-11b', prompt='...', request_id=uid)
```

maria (Docs): Nice. Also add the raw HTTP example for reference:

maria (Docs): ```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Request-Id: 8a6f3c2b-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "redwood-11b", "input": "..." }
```

maria (Docs): We should call out the server warning header that will appear if callers still send Idempotency-Key: 

maria (Docs): ```http
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Warning: 299 - "Idempotency-Key deprecated, use Request-Id\"
```

jen (QA): I'll add a smoke test to the docs CI that hits the canary and verifies: (1) Request-Id dedupes (send twice, same Request-Id -> single job) (2) Idempotency-Key still works but returns a warning header. I need the PR numbers to wire tests to.

samir (SDK): PRs: SDK #7890 (node/python mapping + deprecation warning), Docs #7891 (migration guide + snippets), Smoke tests #7892 (QA). I'll link them in comments.

clem (Frontend): I'll patch the example app repo to use requestId and drop idempotencyKey usage; will keep a small compatibility helper with console warning for one release. PR: frontend-examples#112.

maria (Docs): Action items:
- samir: finish SDK PR and ensure snippet tests updated.
- jen: add smoke tests that validate headers and warning behavior.
- clem: update example app snippets and add migration note in README.
- me: update migration guide and add a short "how to verify" checklist for customers.

maria (Docs): Target: merge all docs + SDK changes 48h before the public deprecation email. Can we hit that?

samir (SDK): Yes, aiming to merge within 36h. I'll post when ready for review.

jen (QA): I'll queue the smoke test run as soon as PRs are open.

docs-bot: Reminder: add changelog entry under Unreleased -> Breaking changes: idempotency header rename.

infra-bot: Canary deployment updated: v2 routing now returns Warning header when Idempotency-Key is used.

maria (Docs): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the docs PR with these snippets and a short migration checklist. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
